第010章 兽兄，对不住了
“你没听见吗？叫得好大声啊。”岳雨邪邪一笑道。
少年微微一怔，随后骂道：“靠，你竟敢说我是狗。”少年这才反应过来，心中怒火升腾。
“呵，狗的反应还不算慢。”岳雨戏谑的笑道。
岳雨一个普通人面对他们竟敢这样说话，少年们表情皆是一变，冷冷的看着岳雨。
“小李，教训一下他。”李狂看着岳雨，目光阴狠。
“哈哈，好！”少年冷笑一声，大步向前一跨，一股凌厉的气息散发而出。
众人用阴冷的眼神注视着岳雨，心中一阵鄙夷与不屑。无法修炼的普通人，在他们眼中就如同蝼蚁一般，随意便可将其虐死。
“一个无法修炼的废物。也敢跟我等通灵境修士叫嚣，真是活的不难烦了，今天就好好教训教训你。”小李不屑的一笑。随即，凌厉的气息陡然一增，一道威压，瞬间压向了岳雨。
感受着如同泰山之重的威压，岳雨苦苦支撑，额头之上细汗密布，双脚微微颤抖。眼光之中怒火闪过，随即便压制了下去。跟这种人动怒，岳雨觉得不值。
“通灵境修士，不过如此。”岳雨一副戏谑的表情，看着小李。
“怎么可能？！”小李心中微微一震，有些惊讶，无法置信。自己通灵境五阶的修为，释放的威压，就算是力武境巅峰修士，都会被瞬间压垮，而面前的一个普通人却扛住了自己的威压，这简直就是不可思议。
周围的少年也是有些惊疑，李狂则是朝着小李呵斥道：“尼他玛的给我用点力，一个普通人都压不倒，没用的东西。”
被李狂喝斥，小李心中虽然不爽，但也不敢表露出来，而是将身上的威压完全释放，死死的压向岳雨，以发泄心头的怨气。
威压增强，岳雨身上的压力陡然增加，一个踉跄险些倒地。沉重的威压，压的他有些喘不过气来。此刻，已是拼尽全力，苦苦支撑。
岳雨极力的支撑，冷冷的瞥了小李一眼，随即看着李狂等人，眼中带着嘲笑之色，异常清晰的说道：“一群傻B。”
“靠！你说什么？！”李狂顿时大怒，同时心中也是也真一阵惊异，一个普通人敢这样跟自己说话，他不怕死吗？
“听不明白？呵，理解能力这么差，说你是傻B都是抬举你了。”岳雨看着李狂，一脸嘲弄之色。
“找死！”李狂眼中杀机毕露，双脚猛然踏出，一股狂暴的气息散发而出，使得周围的树木都微微颤动。
此时，岳雨虽是一脸的嘲笑与淡然，但心中却是十分憋屈，对方仅仅一个威压就使自己动弹不得，没有丝毫反抗之力。

这个强者为尊的世界就是如此，弱者，只会受到欺压与凌辱。
“给我住手！”伴随着一声轻喝，楚莹那美丽的身影闪现。眼神如剑般犀利，一道奇异的气场散发而出，瞬间便锁定住了李狂等人。
众人感受着那奇异的气场，面色难看，脸上浮现一丝痛苦之色。气场，只有虚无境修士才能散发而出，不具有伤害性，就犹如精神束缚一般，将人的身体禁锢，气场越大，承受的压力也越大。
看着楚莹，岳雨心中有些震撼。仅仅一个眼神，便压的李狂等人无法动弹，何等强大？！同时心中越发坚定，“变强！我一定要变强，你们这帮傻B就等着吧。”岳雨暗自发誓。
包括李狂在内的几名少年看着楚莹，一脸的敬畏之色，心中有些害怕。毕竟楚莹的身份可不一般，就算是把李狂灭杀于此，宗内的也不会多管。就是他的师傅，天霄峰长老，也不会因为一个李狂而得罪楚莹。
楚莹不仅是李天阳的关门弟子，在宗内五十名首席弟子之中，排名也是前十。而楚莹还有一个身份，更是让他们忌惮，所以，楚莹不是他们能惹得起的。
此刻，几人想不明白楚莹为何会因为一个普通人而针对自己。一脸敬畏的看着楚莹，眼神之中带着哀求，希望楚莹能放过自己，他们此时连说话的力气也没有，只能用眼神来表达。楚莹也懒得跟这般让人计较，气势内敛，气场消散。几人双腿一软，纷纷坐倒在地，脸上冷汗密布，气喘如牛。
楚莹也没询问起因，只是看着李狂等人，淡淡的说道：“走吧。”
众人一听，如蒙大赦，心中的恐惧随即消散，急忙站起身。小李一脸恭维的说道：“楚师姐，小的有眼不识泰山，多谢您手下留情，我们马上走。”说完便急匆匆的离去。
楚莹转身向屋内走去，同时对着岳雨说道：“进屋吧。”
“你先进去吧，我一会就来。”岳雨轻声说道，楚莹又帮了自己一次，心中也是感激。楚莹轻嗯了一声，便向屋内走去。
岳雨则是看着不远处奄奄一息的灵兽，双眼之中流露出炙热兴奋的神色，就犹如一头饿狼看到食物一般。
“经验啊。”岳雨嘴角勾勒出猥琐的笑容，缓缓向灵兽走了过去。
看着眼前的灵兽，棕黄色的毛发，身体犹如狮身，四肢粗壮，爪子锐利如刀，微弱的气息仍是给人一种威严之感。
此刻，灵兽嘴角鲜血不断地流出，眼神也越发的涣散，显然命不久矣。
“兽兄，你现在很痛苦吧？我看你也活不了了，不如你就成全我吧，放心吧，我会给你一个痛快的，如何？”岳雨一脸纯真的看着灵兽，问道。
灵兽此时连鸣叫的力气都没有了，身体略微抽搐。
“我数三声，你若是不应声，就说明默认了啊。”岳雨无耻的说道，同时数道：“一，二，三！”
见灵兽依旧不应声，便一脸歉意的说道：“兽兄，对不住了，放心吧，我会让你在一瞬间死掉的，不会有任何痛苦。”说完，雷芒指发动，同时暗自想着，“会给多少经验呢？”
现在岳雨很想升级，此时心中不免有些激动。

雷芒萦绕于手指间，犹如一条细蛇，缓缓游动。手指朝着灵兽的脑部轻轻一点，雷芒飞出，直直地向灵兽的额心处击去。
一道巨响声炸起，灵兽身子一颤，痛苦的鸣叫了一声。
“咦？！竟然没死。兽兄，抱歉，我用全力，这次一定会死！”雷芒没有将灵兽杀死，而只是额头处凹陷了一点，岳雨有些惊讶。随后雷芒指在此发动，咻！雷电划过。
灵兽身子又是一颤，岳雨一看，还是没死。毕竟灵兽有着通灵境三阶得修为，肉身的坚硬度还不是雷芒指可以轻易击穿的。
没有多想，雷芒指再次发动。
雷芒指一次又一次的发动，终于，四十五道雷电过后，灵兽终于解脱了一道道雷电轰击在头部之上所带来的痛苦，生命气息消散，闭上了双眼。
叮！你击杀了通灵境三阶灵兽，获得经验值五百。
叮！由于你的经验是达到九百，你能提升一级，是否升级？

Chapter 010 Brother Beast, I’m sorry
"Didn't you hear? It was so loud." Yue Yu said with an evil smile.
The young man was startled for a moment, and then cursed: "Damn, how dare you call me a dog." Only then did the young man react, and anger rose in his heart.
"Haha, the dog's reaction is not too slow." Yue Yu said with a joking smile.
Yue Yu, an ordinary person, dared to speak like this in front of them. The expressions of the young men all changed and they looked at Yue Yu coldly.
"Xiao Li, teach him a lesson." Li Kuang looked at Yue Yu with a sinister look.
"Haha, okay!" The young man sneered, took a big step forward, and a sharp breath came out.
Everyone looked at Yue Yu with cold eyes, feeling a burst of contempt and disdain in their hearts. Ordinary people who are unable to practice are like ants in their eyes, and they can torture them to death at will.
"You are a useless person who cannot cultivate. He dares to shout at me and other psychic realm monks. Life is really easy. I will teach you a lesson today." Xiao Li smiled disdainfully. Immediately, the fierce aura suddenly increased, and a coercion instantly pressed against Yue Yu.
Feeling the pressure as heavy as Mount Tai, Yue Yu struggled to support himself, with sweat covering his forehead and his feet shaking slightly. Anger flashed in his eyes, then suppressed. Yue Yu felt it was not worth getting angry with such a person.
"A spiritual monk, that's all." Yue Yu looked at Xiao Li with a joking expression.
"How is that possible?!" Xiao Li was slightly shocked, a little surprised and unbelievable. With his cultivation at the fifth level of the Psychic Realm, he could unleash pressure that would instantly crush even a peak martial artist. However, an ordinary person in front of him could withstand his own pressure. This was simply unbelievable.
The teenagers around him were also a little surprised, but Li Kuang scolded Xiao Li: "Nitama, please use some force. Even an ordinary person can't overpower you. You're useless."
Although Xiao Li was unhappy after being scolded by Li Kuang, he did not dare to show it. Instead, he completely released the pressure on his body and pressed against Yue Yu to vent his resentment.
As the coercion increased, the pressure on Yue Yu suddenly increased, and he staggered and almost fell to the ground. The heavy pressure made him breathless. At this moment, I was trying my best to support myself.
Yue Yu tried her best to support, glanced at Xiao Li coldly, then looked at Li Kuang and others, with a look of ridicule in his eyes, and said very clearly: "A bunch of idiots."
"Damn! What did you say?!" Li Kuang was furious. At the same time, he was really surprised. An ordinary person dared to talk to him like this. Isn't he afraid of death?
"Can't you understand? Ha, your understanding is so poor. To call you stupid is just flattering you." Yue Yu looked at Li Kuang with a mocking look on his face.
"Seeking death!" Li Kuang's eyes were filled with murderous intent, and he stepped out suddenly with his feet, and a violent aura came out, causing the surrounding trees to tremble slightly.
At this time, although Yue Yu had a face of ridicule and indifference, he felt very aggrieved in his heart. The other party made him unable to move with just a pressure, without any resistance.
This is the world where the strong are respected, and the weak will only be bullied and humiliated.
"Stop!" With a soft shout, Chu Ying's beautiful figure flashed. His eyes were as sharp as swords, and a strange aura emitted, instantly locking onto Li Kuang and others.
Everyone felt the strange aura, their expressions were ugly, and a trace of pain appeared on their faces. The aura can only be emitted by monks in the Void Realm. It is not harmful. It is like a mental restraint, imprisoning the human body. The greater the aura, the greater the pressure.
Looking at Chu Ying, Yue Yu felt a little shocked. With just one look, Li Kuang and others were suppressed and unable to move. How powerful is that? ! At the same time, he became more determined in his heart, "Become stronger! I must become stronger, you idiots just wait." Yue Yu swore secretly.
Several teenagers, including Li Kuang, watchedLooking at Chu Ying, she had a look of awe on her face and a little fear in her heart. After all, Chu Ying's status was not ordinary. Even if Li Kuang was killed here, the people in the sect would not care much about it. Even his master, the elder of Tianxiao Peak, would not offend Chu Ying because of Li Kuang.
Chu Ying is not only Li Tianyang's close disciple, but also ranks among the top ten among the fifty chief disciples in the sect. And Chu Ying also has another identity that makes them even more afraid, so Chu Ying is not something they can afford to offend.
At this moment, several people couldn't understand why Chu Ying would target them because of an ordinary person. They looked at Chu Ying with awe and pleading in their eyes, hoping that Chu Ying could let them go. At this time, they didn't even have the strength to speak and could only express it with their eyes. Chu Ying was too lazy to argue with such people, her aura was restrained and her aura dissipated. Several people's legs weakened and they fell to the ground one after another, their faces covered with cold sweat and they were panting like cows.
Chu Ying didn't ask about the reason. She just looked at Li Kuang and others and said calmly: "Let's go."
When everyone heard this, they felt as if they had been forgiven, and the fear in their hearts immediately dissipated, and they stood up hurriedly. Xiao Li said with a flattering look on his face: "Senior Sister Chu, I am blind to the mountains. Thank you for your mercy. We will leave immediately." After that, he left in a hurry.
Chu Ying turned around and walked into the house, and at the same time said to Yue Yu: "Come in."
"You go in first, I'll be back in a moment." Yue Yu said softly. Chu Ying helped her again, and she was grateful in her heart. Chu Ying hummed softly and walked towards the house.
Yue Yu looked at the dying spirit beast not far away, his eyes showing a hot and excited look, just like a hungry wolf seeing food.
"Experience." A lewd smile appeared on Yue Yu's lips, and she slowly walked towards the spirit beast.
Looking at the spiritual beast in front of me, it has brown hair, a body like a lion, thick limbs, and sharp claws like knives. Its weak aura still gives people a sense of majesty.
At this moment, blood was flowing out from the corner of the spirit beast's mouth, and its eyes were becoming more and more distracted. It was obvious that it was not going to die soon.
"Brother Beast, are you in pain now? I don't think you can survive. Why don't you help me? Don't worry, I will give you a happy one. How about it?" Yue Yu looked at the spirit beast with an innocent face and asked.
At this time, the spirit beast no longer had the strength to even scream, and its body was twitching slightly.
"I'll count three. If you don't answer, it means you acquiesce." Yue Yu said shamelessly, counting at the same time: "One, two, three!"
Seeing that the spirit beast still didn't answer, he said apologetically: "Brother Beast, I'm sorry, don't worry, I will let you die in an instant without any pain." After saying that, he activated his lightning fingers, and at the same time secretly thought, "How much experience will you get?"
Now Yue Yu really wants to upgrade, and she can't help but feel a little excited at this time.
The lightning lingers between the fingers, like a thin snake, swimming slowly. He tapped his finger gently towards the spirit beast's head, and the lightning flew out, hitting the spirit beast's forehead directly.
A loud noise exploded, and the spirit beast trembled and screamed in pain.
"Eh?! He's not dead. Brother Beast, I'm sorry, I'll use all my strength, I will definitely die this time!" Lei Mang did not kill the spirit beast, but only dented the forehead a little, Yue Yu was a little surprised. Then the thunder finger was activated here, phew! Thunder and lightning flashed.
The spirit beast's body trembled again. Yue Yu took a look and saw that it was still not dead. After all, the spirit beast has a cultivation level of the third level of the psychic realm, and its physical body is not so hard that lightning fingers can easily penetrate it.
Without thinking much, the Thunder Finger activated again.
The thunder finger was activated again and again. Finally, after forty-five lightning strikes, the spirit beast was finally freed from the pain caused by the lightning strikes on its head. The breath of life dissipated and it closed its eyes.
bite! You killed a third-level spirit beast in the psychic realm and gained five hundred experience points.
bite! Since your experience reaches 900, you can level up. Do you want to level up?
